Align with the Energy of Friday the 13th

On this day of transformation, harness the protective strength of Morion Smoky Quartz and the illuminating clarity of Selenite. Together, they create a powerful shield that not only wards off misfortune but amplifies your inner light.




Swipe for your ritual.

Find a quiet, comfortable space. Hold Morion Smoky Quartz to ground and protect, and Selenite to cleanse and illuminate. Close your eyes and breathe deeply.

With each inhale, feel the Morion Smoky Quartz anchoring you into the Earth, stabilizing your energy. With each exhale, sense the Selenite expanding your awareness, aligning you with the mystical vibration of today.

Invoke the Crystal Armor 
of Protection

Hold the crystals and imagine the energy of Friday the 13th swirling around you, dissolving superstition and fear, and turning them into strength. 

See Morion Smoky Quartz building an impenetrable shield around you—rooted in the Earth, strong against any fear or misfortune. Let a soft, radiant light expand through your Selenite, clearing your aura and unveiling hidden truths.

Visualize the deep, grounding energy of Morion Smoky Quartz fusing with the light, clarifying energy of Selenite. Together, they form a shimmering crystalline armor around you—strong yet fluid, reflecting both strength and grace. 

Place the Morion Smoky Quartz at your feet, letting it root you deeply into the Earth, anchoring the protection. 

Hold the Selenite above your head, allowing its light to cascade over you, sealing the energetic armor you’ve created. 

Feel the balance between strength and clarity encircling you, both grounded and illuminated.
Sit for a few moments in stillness. Feel the energy of protection settle into your body like a warm embrace.

Sometimes usefulness — doing more or doing it all — becomes tied to safety or worth because of the way it was rewarded in the past.

Maybe you were praised for being mature, helpful, easy or responsible. Or things went more smoothly when you didn’t need much. Maybe you learned being useful kept you connected, protected, or out of conflict.
